company.name: DeepMap
company.shortDescription: DeepMap is accelerating safe autonomy by providing the world's best autonomous mapping and localization solutions.
company.description: DeepMap is accelerating safe autonomy by providing the world's best autonomous mapping and localization solutions. DeepMap delivers the technology necessary for self-driving vehicles to navigate in a complex and unpredictable environment. The company addresses three important elements: precise high-definition (HD) mapping, ultra-accurate real-time localization, and the serving infrastructure to support massive global scaling. DeepMap was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, Calif., with offices in Beijing and Guangzhou, China. Investors include Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, GSR Ventures, Generation, Goldman Sachs, NVIDIA, and Robert Bosch Venture Capital.

aiResearchSummary.text: DeepMap focuses on enhancing autonomous vehicle navigation through various localization techniques, including optimizing HD map-based localization and improving GNSS signal-based positioning. They are developing camera-based localization without depth sensors like LiDAR and creating HD maps that detail lane lines and traffic features. Their R&D includes generating synthetic sensor data, calibrating sensors, and training data for dynamic objects using HD maps. They also work on annotating map data with semantic labels, detecting ground features for deep learning models, and updating maps based on lane closures.
